posts.title: What Acme Savings is
posts.caption:
Save together, see every step.

Acme Savings is one place for group savings, goals and records. Every deposit is recorded the day it is made, so the whole group knows where the money is.

See how it works: https://acmesavings.example

posts.title: How a group works
posts.caption:
A savings group is a circle of people who put in a fixed amount on a fixed day. Acme Savings records each deposit and shows every member what they have put in.

#AcmeSavings #SavingsGroups #SaveTogether

x.caption: A savings group puts in a fixed amount on a fixed day. Acme Savings records each deposit.

posts.title: Group goals
posts.caption:
A group can set a shared goal, and everyone sees how close it is.

posts.title: Two-person approval
posts.caption:
A payout needs a second person in the group to approve it before it is recorded as paid.

#AcmeSavings #SavingsGroups #SaveTogether

design.myth: One person can pay out the pot.
design.fact: A payout is recorded as paid only after a second member approves it.

x.caption: Every payout needs a second person to approve it.
